solutions.check: grid rebuilt from the blog's light list (unique); every answer written into it with each crossing agreeing

clue.text: Timid about a B&B that's dirty?

indicators.note: about tells us the timid word wraps round the next pieces

parts.note: timid means shy
B&B is written as its two letters, B and B

explanation.surface: Someone shy is asking whether a cheap bed and breakfast is grubby.
explanation.definitionFit: Shabby describes something worn and grubby, close in sense to dirty, with the question mark softening the stretch.

clue.text: Special policemen releasing several imprisoned characters for example

indicators.note: releasing means letting go, so the confined letters are removed from the phrase

parts.note: the letters locked inside the middle of the phrase, between its start and finish

explanation.surface: Special constables free some prisoners as a test case.
explanation.walkthrough: Cut AL POLICE out of the middle of 'Special policemen' and SPECI joins MEN; 'for' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: A specimen is an individual example taken as typical of its kind.

clue.text: Leader of academy donated a plant

indicators.note: leader of picks the first letter of the word academy

parts.note: donated means gave

explanation.surface: The head of a school has given a pot plant.
explanation.definitionFit: The agave is a succulent plant of the Americas, source of tequila and sisal.

clue.text: Black donkey seen around British isle with a whole lot of plants and animals

definitions.text: a whole lot of plants and animals

indicators.note: seen around means found near, placing the donkey beside the island letters

parts.note: B is the abbreviation for black, as on pencils
IOM stands for the Isle of Man
an ass is a donkey

explanation.surface: A dark donkey is spotted roaming a British island along with many creatures.
explanation.definitionFit: Biomass is the total quantity of living organisms in a given area.

clue.text: This writer's wanting agreement to make impression

parts.note: the setter calling themself this writer gives I'M, short for I am
a pact is an agreement

explanation.surface: A writer needs a deal signed in order to make their mark.
explanation.definitionFit: An impact is the impression or effect something makes, a close synonym.

clue.text: Wine's second retail outlet running short

parts.note: a mo is a moment, a second

indicators.note: running short means losing the last letter, so the seller word is clipped

parts.note: a seller is an outlet for goods

explanation.surface: A shop is running low on a wine in a moment.
explanation.definitionFit: Moselle is a German white wine from the valley of the river of that name.

clue.text: Great thinker, exceptional sort with tale to engage one

indicators.note: to engage means to take in, so the jumble holds the single letter
exceptional signals an unusual arrangement of the letters of sort and tale

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: An extraordinary character with a story wins over a famous mind.
explanation.walkthrough: 'exceptional' makes ARSTOTLE, and 'to engage' takes in I; 'sort' looks like a noun for a person but is fodder.
explanation.definitionFit: The ancient Greek philosopher was one of history's greatest thinkers.

clue.text: Sort of girl that's grave with zero yen

parts.note: a tomb is a grave
O looks like zero
Y is the abbreviation for the Japanese yen

explanation.surface: A serious young woman with no money.
explanation.definitionFit: A tomboy is a girl who enjoys rough, boisterous activities.

clue.text: Outside old university see awful rabble making attack

indicators.note: outside tells us the jumbled crowd sits around the old university letters
awful signals that the letters of rabble are rearranged into a messy new order

explanation.surface: A dreadful mob gathers outside an old college to launch an assault.
explanation.walkthrough: 'awful' turns RABBLE into BELABR, which wraps round OU to give the answer; 'see' and 'making' are only link words.
explanation.definitionFit: To belabour someone is to attack them, with blows or with words.

clue.text: A celebrity turning up in the distance — Scot who has dreadlocks?

indicators.note: turning up, in a down clue, sends the bottom letter round to the top

parts.note: a star is a celebrity
far means at a distance
Ian is a typical Scottish man's name

explanation.surface: A famous person appears far off, a Scotsman wearing dreadlocks.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turning up' moves the last letter of ASTAR to the top, giving RASTA.
explanation.definitionFit: Followers of the Rastafarian movement often wear their hair in dreadlocks, so this is a definition by example.

clue.text: Blemish of Greek character — that's about tax primarily?

indicators.note: about tells us the Greek letter goes round the next piece

parts.note: sigma is a letter of the Greek alphabet

indicators.note: primarily picks out the first letter of the word tax

explanation.surface: A question about whether a Greek's flaw is chiefly to do with taxes.
explanation.definitionFit: A stigma is a mark of disgrace, figuratively a blemish on someone's reputation.

clue.text: Rasp in row

definitions.meaning: a rasp is a coarse tool for smoothing wood or nails
a line of people one behind another, as in single order

explanation.definitionFit: A file is both a rasping tool and a line of people walking one behind another.

clue.text: Troubled soul? Obtain forgiveness

indicators.note: troubled signals that the letters of the following words are stirred into a new order

explanation.surface: A tormented spirit is told to go and seek pardon.
explanation.definitionFit: Absolution is the formal release from sin, a kind of forgiveness granted by a priest.

clue.text: What could be statement in Holy Writ

parts.note: read the two answer words as an instruction: rearranging the second word, as new suggests, gives statement

explanation.surface: Someone wonders which declaration might be found in Scripture.
explanation.walkthrough: This is a reverse clue: treat 'new' as an anagram signal and the following word's letters make 'statement'.
explanation.definitionFit: The second part of the Christian Bible is Scripture, which is what Holy Writ means.

clue.text: Numbers in the old days you would get on beach

parts.note: thou is the archaic word for you
sands are a beach

explanation.surface: Lots of people in years gone by headed for the seaside.
explanation.definitionFit: Thousands means great numbers, a very large quantity.

clue.text: Institute's period of time for accommodating call

indicators.note: accommodating means housing, so the period holds the call

parts.note: a bout is a spell or period
to ring is to call by phone

explanation.surface: An institute takes a while before it will take a call.
explanation.definitionFit: To bring out a product is to introduce or launch it, so to institute it.

clue.text: Traveller's joy? Senior citizen experiences it as hairy

definitions.meaning: traveller's joy is a wild clematis with fluffy seed heads

definitions.text: Senior citizen experiences it as hairy
definitions.meaning: an elderly man's chin whiskers are hairy, read literally

explanation.definitionFit: The plant is also called by the name of an elderly man's facial hair because its feathery seeds look like whiskers.

clue.text: Terrific marksman that sees nothing?

definitions.meaning: an expert shot who never misses
an eye that is lifeless cannot see

explanation.definitionFit: A deadeye is a superb shot, and read literally a lifeless eye sees nothing.

clue.text: No. 5 for Leeds, one who cries as a player on the field?

indicators.note: No. 5 picks the fifth letter of the word Leeds

parts.note: a weeper is someone who cries

explanation.surface: A Leeds footballer wearing the number five shirt cries on the pitch.
explanation.definitionFit: A sweeper is a defensive footballer who plays behind the back line.

clue.text: Unhappy about page and about facing pages

indicators.note: about tells us the unhappy word goes round the other pieces

parts.note: unhappy means sad
re means about, concerning

explanation.surface: Someone is upset over a page and the pages opposite it.
explanation.definitionFit: A spread is a pair of facing pages in a magazine or newspaper.

clue.text: A comic Frenchman in group is to abandon principles

indicators.note: in tells us the comedian goes inside the group

parts.note: a posse is a group of people
Jacques Tati was a French comic actor and film-maker

explanation.surface: A French comedian who joins a gang is giving up his ideals.
explanation.definitionFit: To apostatise is to renounce one's faith or beliefs, so to give up one's principles.

clue.text: List of chaps attending university

parts.note: chaps are men

explanation.surface: A roll of the fellows who go to college.
explanation.definitionFit: A menu is a list, of dishes or of computer options.

clue.text: Yours truly's penning brief line as children's author

indicators.note: penning means enclosing, so the possessive holds the short line

parts.note: yours truly is me, and what belongs to me is mine
L is the abbreviation for line

explanation.surface: I am jotting a quick line, as a writer for children might.
explanation.definitionFit: A. A. Milne wrote the Winnie-the-Pooh stories for children.

clue.text: This writer that is penning article, an unkind type

indicators.note: penning means enclosing, so the article sits inside the other letters

parts.note: the setter referring to themself gives ME
an is the indefinite article

explanation.surface: A writer drafting a piece about a nasty character.
explanation.definitionFit: A meanie is a mean, ungenerous or unkind person.

clue.text: French refusal to accept a European dictator

indicators.note: to accept means to take in, so the refusal holds the other pieces

parts.note: non is French for no
a Pole is a European from Poland

explanation.surface: A Frenchman refuses to let a Pole in, as an autocrat might.
explanation.definitionFit: Napoleon Bonaparte ruled France as an autocratic emperor, a classic example of a dictator.

clue.text: Before start of ritual saint must be clothed in proper cloth

indicators.note: before places what follows ahead of the opening letter of ritual
clothed in means wrapped inside, so the saint goes inside the proper word

parts.note: due means proper or fitting

indicators.note: start of picks the first letter of the word ritual

explanation.surface: Ahead of a ceremony, a saint must be dressed in the right vestments.
explanation.definitionFit: A duster is a cloth used for wiping away dust.

clue.text: Impassioned founder of cosmetics firm, foremost in toiletry

parts.note: Elizabeth Arden founded the cosmetics company bearing her name

indicators.note: foremost picks out the leading letter of the word toiletry

explanation.surface: A beauty entrepreneur is passionate about leading the toiletries market.
explanation.definitionFit: Ardent means burning with feeling, so impassioned or fervent.
